Alice —

Appreciate the patience while we consulted our engineering and security teams. We reviewed the operational impact and will accept the 48-hour substantive reporting requirement with the following narrowly scoped conditions (intended to be operational, not legal carve-outs):

1) "48-hour Substantive Report" applies when Redwood has reasonable evidence of confirmed unauthorized access to customer data or confirmed unauthorized exfiltration. For events that are suspected but unconfirmed, Redwood will provide an acknowledgement within 48 hours and a substantive report within a reasonable follow-up window (not to exceed 72 hours from acknowledgement).
2) If third-party criminal investigations or law enforcement restrict disclosure, we will notify the customer that we are limited in the level of detail we can provide and will share what we are legally permitted to.
3) The incident report will include: summary of impact, root-cause (if available), actions taken, affected data categories, and mitigation steps. We will not include raw logs or PII in the report; those may be provided under secure, scoped forensics requests.
4) We will keep FinEdge updated with regular milestones until remediation.

We have attached a final redline (DPA_Redline_v3.docx) reflecting these edits and a CSV of current subprocessors.
